He is a member of Maharashtra Legislative Council since 2020, the president of Maha Vikas Aghadi since 2019 and the president of Shiv Sena (UBT) "Shiv Sena (UBT)") since 2022. He was also the leader (*pramukh*) of Shiv Sena "Shiv Sena (1966–2022)") from 2013 to 2022, working President from 2003 to 2013 and the editor-in-chief of *Saamana* from 2006 to 2019. After the death of his father Bal Thackeray in 2012, he led the party and was elected as Shiv Sena president in 2013, and under his leadership Shiv Sena joined the NDA government in Maharashtra in 2014.
